segmentPatterns.label: Scatter Distribution Onboarding and Benchmark Sampling
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Defines metrics, demonstrates extremes and averages via known entities, then escalates to top performers.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Full scatter plot populates, labels explain axes, camera tracks across sample nodes before focusing on outliers.

segmentPatterns.label: Action-Reaction Narrative Hook
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Bold superlative claim followed by specific evidence and social proof of impact.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Rapid montage of focal subject performing core actions cut directly against crowd/peer reactions.

segmentPatterns.label: Sequential Ladder with Twist Header
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: List historical predecessors with low numbers to set expectations, then crown the subject and twist the metric definition.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Ascending vertical ranking populated item by item, culminating in a top row reveal followed by a clarifying annotation.

segmentPatterns.label: Rapid Cohort Baseline Setup
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Describe normal standards across multiple peers to set a contrast anchor.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Snappy B-roll sequence matching each spoken entity to a characteristic action.

segmentPatterns.label: Exclusive Benchmark Lineup
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Claim that only a tiny group in history achieved a specific metric benchmark, naming members sequentially.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Anchor subject on one flank; slide in full-body transparent cutouts and stat cards sequentially as each entity is spoken.

segmentPatterns.label: Record Monopoly Cumulative Stack
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Asserting that a high standard is held almost exclusively by one entity across multiple categories or eras.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Stacked vertical stat rows populated sequentially, repeating the same identity card to visually emphasize total dominance.

segmentPatterns.label: Layered Trendline Evolution
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Chronological claim supported by efficiency metric, followed by volume metric, resolved with overall trend.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: A line chart draws the first line, pins callouts at extremes, overlays a second line, then draws a trendline across both.

segmentPatterns.label: Scrolling Excluded-Target Reveal
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Claim that a prominent subject is completely overlooked on an official ranking list.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Vertical ranking scroll displays recognized contenders and ends on a custom 'N/A' row for the subject.

segmentPatterns.label: Cross-Domain Scatter Elimination
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Claims that two specialist categories do not overlap, then reveals a single subject operating in both.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Presents two separate metric plots, cross-plots the specialists in their weak category, and highlights the outlier.

segmentPatterns.label: Chronological Multi-Role Evolution
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Argues exceptional versatility across distinct eras or functional roles over a career.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Horizontal timeline displaying entity markers, augmented by secondary proof metrics on each milestone.

segmentPatterns.label: Ascending Data Distribution Ladder
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Define a metric -> introduce full spectrum -> travel from negative baseline through medians -> reveal apex outliers -> situate focal subject.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Scatter plot visual overview -> zoom into lower baseline -> continuous upward camera pan tagging tiers -> snap to target subject -> macro zoom-out.

segmentPatterns.label: Blackout Reset Pause
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Solid black hold clearing the viewer's field of view.
